fresh.title: FBI National Crime Information Center breached in second incident
fresh.summary: FBI systems containing the National Crime Information Center database were breached by attackers. The incident marks the second time the agency has been compromised within two months.

sources.title: FBI reportedly hacked again, this time targeting nationwide police database

fresh.title: Malicious Webpage Vulnerability Lets Researchers Hijack Meta Muse
fresh.summary: Researchers demonstrated that a malicious webpage could extract private conversations, stored memories, and connected account credentials from Meta Muse without approval prompts. The issue was found in a laboratory setting with no real-world exploitation reported.

sources.title: A Single Malicious Webpage Let Researchers Hijack Meta Muse and Access Private Chats

fresh.title: AI agents discover zero‑day in MONAI Label allowing unauthenticated file write and root access
fresh.summary: Attackers using autonomous AI agents identified a previously unknown vulnerability in the MONAI Label medical‑imaging server that permits unauthenticated file‑write outside its storage directory. The flaw was exploited to gain root access on a university server; no patch is currently available.
fresh.action: Monitor for patches and mitigate by restricting file‑write permissions

sources.title: Attackers' AI Agents Found a Zero-Day in Medical-Imaging Software and Gained Root Access
Amazon: China-Linked Hackers’ AI Agents Exploited Medical Software Zero-Day

fresh.title: Too Lost data breach exposes 724,323 accounts
fresh.summary: An unauthorised party obtained data from music distributor Too Lost, exposing 724,323 accounts. The leaked information included email addresses, bcrypt password hashes, partial credit card data, and identity verification documents.

sources.title: Too Lost data breach exposes 724,323 accounts

fresh.title: Bell Canada Confirms Enterprise Data Breach Following Cyberattack
fresh.summary: Bell Canada confirmed that threat actors breached its systems and stole enterprise customer data. The compromised information includes data from a telecommunications ordering and provisioning system.

sources.title: Bell Canada says 'agentic' hacker stole enterprise customer data

fresh.title: CVE-2026-23871: WhatsApp Patches Flaw Suspected of In-The-Wild Abuse
fresh.summary: Meta patched a security vulnerability in WhatsApp for Android that may have been exploited in scam messages. The issue involves incomplete validation of external ad-reply URLs.
fresh.action: Update WhatsApp for Android and WhatsApp Business to version 2.26.17.4 or later.

sources.title: WhatsApp Patches 3 Security Flaws, Including Android Bug Suspected of Use in Scams

fresh.title: CVE-2025-42884: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal Improper Neutralization Vulnerability
fresh.summary: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization flaw in data query logic allowing unauthenticated server information disclosure or modification. CISA added the vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog following confirmation of active exploitation.
fresh.action: Apply vendor mitigations and updates in accordance with CISA guidance.

sources.title: CVE-2025-42884: SAP NetWeaver — SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability

fresh.title: China-linked threat actors used Cairn AI tool to attack universities
fresh.summary: Threat actors utilized the open-source AI penetration testing tool Cairn to persistently attack two universities. The attacks resulted in the possible discovery of an unpatched zero-day vulnerability.

sources.title: Amazon says Chinese hackers used Cairn AI tool to discover apparent zero-day during attack on university
Chinese attackers used AI agents to find and exploit a university zero-day
Chinese-nexus actor's Cairn AI agents found a zero-day on their own

fresh.title: Bazuka Android Malware Framework Discovered with LLM Integration for Credential Theft
fresh.summary: Researchers uncovered Bazuka, an Android malware framework that uses fake screen overlays to steal credentials and control devices. The malware incorporates large language model capabilities to manage victims at scale.
fresh.action: Analyze and block Bazuka samples, update mobile security solutions, and monitor for LLM‑enabled malicious activity.

sources.title: Bazuka Android Malware Uses Fake Screen Overlays to Hide Credential Theft and Device Control

fresh.title: Vendor data breach exposes Chase, Visa, Mastercard customer info
fresh.summary: J.P. Morgan Chase disclosed a data breach originating from a third‑party service provider that exposed personal and marketing data of its customers, including Visa and Mastercard holders. The breach resulted in the compromise of sensitive customer information.
fresh.action: Investigate the breach and notify affected customers

sources.title: Vendor data breach exposes Chase, Visa, Mastercard customer info

fresh.title: Abusing Browser-Embedded Language Models for Post-Exploitation
fresh.summary: Researchers demonstrated that browser-embedded local language models can be abused as post-exploitation engines. The technique utilizes built-in AI endpoints to run invisible analysis and processing tasks.

sources.title: Living off the Local Model: Abusing Browser-Embedded Language Models for Post-Exploitation

fresh.title: ALIoTh: Orchestrating Multi-Agent LLMs for Autonomous IoT Penetration Testing
fresh.summary: Researchers introduced ALIoTh, a multi-agent framework powered by large language models designed to autonomously execute penetration testing across Internet of Things environments. The system integrates a self-retrieval-augmented generation architecture to handle information gathering and lateral movement.

sources.title: ALIoTh: Orchestrating Multi-Agent LLMs for Autonomous IoT Penetration Testing

fresh.title: Authority Closure and Authorization Boundaries in Agent Commerce Protocols
fresh.summary: Researchers analyzed how software agent commerce protocols and crypto wallets can permit unauthorized transfers due to gaps between displayed fields and signed objects. The study defines authority closure to characterize transfer sequences enabled by signed objects.

sources.title: Signed, Valid, and Unauthorized: Authority Closure at the Trust Boundary Between Agent Commerce Protocols and Crypto Wallets

fresh.title: BlockJack: Cross-Tenant Redirection Fault Attacks on Paged KV Cache
fresh.summary: Researchers demonstrated BlockJack, a cross-tenant redirection fault attack targeting paged KV cache address translation in LLM serving frameworks like vLLM. The technique manipulates software-managed memory translation layers to compromise tenant isolation during inference.

sources.title: BlockJack: Cross-Tenant Redirection Fault Attacks on Paged KV Cache Address Translation in LLM Serving

fresh.title: N-able Suffers Service Disruption Due to Cyberattack
fresh.summary: N-able attributed a service disruption affecting Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud to a cyberattack. The incident potentially exposed users to credential theft risks.

sources.title: N-able Blames Service Disruption on Cyberattack
N-able says recent security breach led to major service outage

fresh.title: European Commission confirms AI-assisted cyberattack disrupted systems
fresh.summary: The European Commission confirmed it suffered a cyberattack utilizing a publicly available AI tool, forcing several internal applications offline. Officials acknowledged the incident during a press briefing following initial reporting.

sources.title: European Commission confirms AI-generated cyberattack disrupted its systems
European Commission Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattack Disrupted Services

fresh.title: Careers360 data breach exposes 3,609,421 accounts
fresh.summary: In November 2026, user data from Indian education platform Careers360 was leaked on a public hacking forum. The breach exposed over 3.6 million unique accounts containing personal details, phone numbers, and academic records.

sources.title: Careers360 data breach exposes 3,609,421 accounts

fresh.title: JPMorgan, Visa, Mastercard Cite Third-Party Incidents Amid Data Leak
fresh.summary: JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard disclosed that a data leak attributed to the N0n extortion group exposed customer information, blaming third‑party providers. The incident highlights supply‑chain risks in the payments ecosystem.
fresh.action: Investigate the third‑party providers and remediate exposed data

sources.title: JPMorgan, Visa, Mastercard Cite Third-Party Incidents Amid Data Leak

fresh.title: ROMULUS ClickFix Attacks Deliver RAT That Can Spy on Users and Control PCs
fresh.summary: Threat actors used the ROMULUS ClickFix platform to deliver a previously undocumented remote access trojan similar to CNCMachineRMS. The platform also distributes Legion Loader using signed binary sideloading techniques.
fresh.action: Monitor for indicators of compromise and block the ROMULUS ClickFix delivery chain

sources.title: ROMULUS ClickFix Attacks Deliver RAT That Can Spy on Users and Control PCs

fresh.title: SBC Medical Group discloses data breach affecting 1.6 million customers
fresh.summary: SBC Medical Group reported that two cyberattacks exposed sensitive customer and employee data affecting 1.6 million individuals. The incident was disclosed in an SEC filing.

sources.title: Hackers steal data of 1.6 million SBC Medical Group customers
SBC Medical Group Data Breach Impacts Over 2 Million

fresh.title: Transport for London data breach exposes 265,000 Oyster card user accounts
fresh.summary: Transport for London confirmed a data breach exposing personal account details of approximately 265,000 Oyster photocard users. The incident resulted in unauthorized access to customer data.
fresh.action: Review account security and monitor for suspicious activity related to exposed Oyster card details.

sources.title: Transport for London breach exposes 265,000 Oyster card users' data
265,000 Oyster photocard customers’ data exposed in Transport for London breach

fresh.title: Critical VMware vCenter Flaw Allows Network Attackers to Bypass Authentication
fresh.summary: VMware disclosed a critical vulnerability in vCenter that allows network‑connected attackers to bypass authentication and gain full control. The vendor released patches for all supported branches, with no workaround available.
fresh.action: Apply the latest patched version of VMware vCenter

sources.title: Critical VMware vCenter Flaw (CVSS 9.8) Lets Network Attackers Bypass Authentication
Newly Patched VMware vCenter Flaw Exploited as Zero-Day by Chinese APT
VMware patches vCenter zero-day exploited in attacks since September

fresh.title: ARMORY CASTLE exploits VMware vSphere in post-compromise intrusions
fresh.summary: Mandiant and Google Threat Intelligence observed threat actor ARMORY CASTLE targeting VMware vSphere environments during post-exploitation activities following initial access via BeyondTrust Remote Support. The campaign demonstrates active lateral movement and persistence within compromised virtual infrastructure.
fresh.action: Audit VMware vSphere and BeyondTrust environments for unauthorized lateral movement and enforce credential isolation.

sources.title: ARMORY CASTLE Exploits vSphere

fresh.title: Ukraine exposes ransomware network extorting US oil, healthcare firms
fresh.summary: Ukrainian authorities arrested four suspected members of an international ransomware group accused of extorting more than $40 million from U.S. oil and healthcare companies. The arrests expose the network’s operations and its large‑scale financial impact.

sources.title: Ukraine exposes ransomware network extorting US oil, healthcare firms

fresh.title: Hackers Exploit Cisco Expressway Vulnerability Soon After PoC Release
fresh.summary: Attackers exploited a vulnerability in Cisco Expressway after a proof‑of‑concept was released, compromising a clustered deployment at a Russian organization. They used the access to set up tooling for lateral movement within the network.

sources.title: Hackers Exploit Cisco Expressway Vulnerability Soon After PoC Release
Hackers Exploit Critical Cisco Expressway Flaw, Breach Four Devices and Reach Internal Network
CVE-2026-76466: Cisco Expressway Series — Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability

fresh.title: CVE-2026-115560: PHP Critical Security Release Advisory
fresh.summary: PHP published an emergency security release regarding CVE-2026-115560. Technical details and fixed versions are currently developing.
fresh.action: Apply the latest PHP security updates immediately to mitigate remote code execution risks.

sources.title: PHP Rings the Alarm Again: What We Know (and Don’t) About Today’s Critical PHP Security Release
PHP Fixes 7 Critical Flaws, Including Bugs That Could Allow Remote Code Execution
PHP security updates fix 18 flaws, including critical RCE bugs

fresh.title: CISA KEV Adds Exploited Flaws in LiteLLM, Synology, Axis, and REDCap
fresh.summary: CISA added four vulnerabilities affecting LiteLLM, Synology DiskStation Manager, Apache Axis, and REDCap to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. The additions follow evidence of active exploitation in the wild.
fresh.action: Apply vendor patches or mitigations listed in the CISA KEV catalog.

sources.title: CISA Warns of 4 Exploited Flaws Linked to Ransomware, Cryptomining, and LLMjacking Attacks

fresh.title: N-able Cloud Server Breach Disrupts Email Security Management
fresh.summary: N-able reported unauthorized access to a server within its hosted email security cloud environment. The incident caused the temporary disabling of management interfaces and APIs across three regions.
fresh.action: Review N-able advisory updates and monitor cloud service status.
products: Mail Assure and Spam Experts Hosted Cloud

sources.title: Hackers Breach N-able Cloud Server, Disrupting Email Security Management Across 3 Regions

fresh.title: Java4Shell Exploitation Attempts Begin as Vendors Rush Out Advisories
fresh.summary: Security firms report probing and exploit attempts targeting Java4Shell, prompting vendors like Cisco, Elastic, Red Hat, and Siemens to issue advisories. Affected organisations must apply available patches and monitor perimeter telemetry.
fresh.action: Review vendor advisories and apply available patches immediately.

sources.title: Java4Shell Exploitation Attempts Begin as Vendors Rush Out Advisories

fresh.title: NVIDIA investigating Gentlemen ransomware breach claims
fresh.summary: NVIDIA is investigating claims of a security breach after the Gentlemen ransomware group listed the company on its dark web leak site. The impact of the alleged intrusion remains under review.
fresh.action: Monitor official updates from NVIDIA and review internal access logs.

sources.title: NVIDIA investigating Gentlemen ransomware breach claims
Nvidia Responds to Gentlemen Ransomware Claim

fresh.title: CVE-2024-10441: Synology DSM and BeeStation OS Output Escaping Vulnerability
fresh.summary: Synology DiskStation Manager and BeeStation OS contain an improper encoding vulnerability in the system plugin daemon allowing arbitrary code execution. CISA confirmed exploitation in the wild.
fresh.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions.

sources.title: CVE-2024-10441: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) — Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability

fresh.title: CVE-2026-90436: Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
fresh.summary: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via SOAP fault messages. CISA confirmed exploitation in the wild.
fresh.action: Discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

sources.title: CVE-2026-90436: Apache Axis — Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability

fresh.title: CVE-2026-90817: Vanderbilt University REDCap Code Injection Vulnerability
fresh.summary: Vanderbilt University REDCap contains a code injection vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted HTTP requests. CISA confirmed exploitation in the wild.
fresh.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions.

sources.title: CVE-2026-90817: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) — Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability

fresh.title: CVE-2026-123007: Critical vulnerabilities in NGINX allow remote code execution
fresh.summary: F5 disclosed five vulnerabilities in NGINX enabling unauthenticated remote attackers to execute code with worker process privileges. While researchers demonstrated CVE-2026-123007, no active in-the-wild exploitation has been reported.
fresh.action: Update NGINX to the latest patched version immediately, prioritizing internet-facing appliances.

sources.title: 2026-022: Critical vulnerabilities in Nginx
10-Year-Old NGINX HTTP/2 Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Execute Code on Servers
F5 Patches Critical NGINX2Root Flaws as PoC Exploits Go Public
